description.value: White Rock Beach Beer Company is a craft microbrewery founded in 2013 by two local secondary school teachers, operating a tasting room and lounge where visitors can try a range of house beers on tap. The lineup spans lagers, pilsners, pale ales, wheat ales, an IPA, and a porter, all brewed on-site and available by the glass or as growler fills and canned 6-packs to take away. Located near the White Rock waterfront — a popular Lower Mainland cycling corridor — it makes a relaxed stop for riders exploring the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an operating craft microbrewery with a tasting room/lounge in White Rock, BC. Phone number (+1-604-319-4378) matches between OSM and the website. Address is problematic: OSM lists 15183 Russell Street (V4B 2P4), the website contact footer consistently shows 15181 Russell Ave, White Rock, BC V4B 3Z6, though the About page references 15183 Russell Avenue as the 'new tasting room' — making the current operating address ambiguous. No cycling-specific amenities (bike racks, pump, Wi-Fi, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere on the website; takeout is clearly evidenced by the growler fill and canned 6-pack offerings described on the beers page.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists 15183 Russell Street, V4B 2P4; website contact footer across all pages shows 15181 Russell Ave, White Rock, BC V4B 3Z6. The About page separately references 15183 Russell Avenue as the 'new tasting room' location — it is unclear which number and postal code is currently correct.
Name discrepancy: OSM records the business as 'White Rock Beach Beer' but the website consistently uses the full name 'White Rock Beach Beer Company'.
OSM community field lists 'Tsawwassen' but the business is located in White Rock, BC — a separate incorporated municipality.
Website copyright footers date to 2017–2018 and content appears infrequently updated; most recent datable content is an October 2023 open-mic event reference.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate local microbrewery with a tasting room near the White Rock waterfront — a well-known Lower Mainland cycling destination. Takeout growlers and cans are well-suited to touring cyclists; address ambiguity should be resolved before publishing.
